name: PhD Program in Neurobiology
summary: PhD training across approaches and model systems for studying the nervous system. First-year students complete at least two lab rotations to identify a thesis laboratory and advisor.

deadlines.label: Application and all supporting materials
deadlines.note: The current Biosciences deadline for Autumn 2027 supplies the date; Neurobiology's page says early December without a year.

timeline.interviews: Programs may invite applicants directly for interviews in January.
timeline.decisions: Formal decision letters are sent through the admissions website in February–March.

english.toefl: Tests on/after 21 January 2026: Reading and Writing at least 5, Listening at least 5.5, Speaking at least 4.5. Earlier tests: 100 overall; Reading, Writing and Listening at least 26; Speaking at least 22.
english.note: IELTS Academic: at least 7 in each section. Scores must be from December 1, 2024 or later. TOEFL iBT or IELTS Academic is required unless a University primary-language or education waiver applies.

applicationFee.note: Specific waiver categories are listed, with requests made after application submission through the status portal. Do not pay before the waiver decision; fees are non-refundable. The page doesn't limit fee waivers by citizenship, so international applicants should confirm with the university that they qualify.

documents: Unofficial transcripts displaying the awarding institution's seal, from each degree-granting postsecondary institution; original-language copies with an authorized English translation when needed
requirements.note: GRE submission is optional. Biosciences says most programs do not consider submitted scores, and names Medical Physics and Biochemistry and Molecular Biophysics as programs that do; the opened pages do not give a separate score-consideration rule for this program.

funding.note: Support includes tuition and fees and a living stipend. Support is guaranteed for the first five years subject to satisfactory progress, and is extended to degree completion in all but unusual circumstances. The published 2026–27 package is not a confirmed 2027–28 amount or benefits package.
